subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He became very annoyed. (b) He wanted to teach his friend a good lesson. (c) The poet had to pay double postage. (d) He packed it up double postage. (e) So, he procured a heavy stone. (f) During his stay he received an unpaid letter from his friend. (g) The letter contained nothing but some words. (h) An English poet was staying in Italy for the benefit of his health.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
